aboutClinic.title: About the Clinic & Treatment Approach
aboutClinic.leadCopy: RevitaOrtho is a dedicated outpatient physical therapy center equipped with modern European rehabilitation technology and private sanitized treatment suites, focused on helping patients recover naturally without unnecessary invasive procedures.

approaches.title: Comprehensive Diagnostic
approaches.desc: Detailed evaluation of joint mobility angles, nerve tension signs, and kinetic imbalances before treatment.

approaches.title: Dedicated 1-on-1 Specialist Focus
approaches.desc: Every session is led directly by a qualified therapist with focused individual attention.

approaches.title: Advanced Non-Surgical Technologies
approaches.desc: Modern photobiomodulation, computerized decompression, and cellular oscillation modalities.

approaches.title: Long-Term Prevention
approaches.desc: Structured progressive milestones and ergonomic training to prevent recurrent episodes.

whyChooseUs.title: Qualified Therapists
whyChooseUs.desc: All evaluations and therapies are delivered directly by specialized clinical physiotherapists with verified hospital experience — never delegated to uncertified trainees.

whyChooseUs.title: Personalized 1-on-1 Care
whyChooseUs.desc: We dedicate full 45-minute sessions to you with tailored, evidence-based rehabilitation protocols. No multitasking and no generic cookie-cutter treatments.

whyChooseUs.title: Convenient Appointments
whyChooseUs.desc: Flexible consultation slots from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Monday through Saturday) with zero waiting time at our modern wellness center — plus home visit care options.

treatmentSteps.title: Book Appointment
treatmentSteps.desc: Select your preferred in-clinic slot or request a home visit easily online or by calling 9145875248.

treatmentSteps.title: Comprehensive Assessment
treatmentSteps.desc: Thorough physical and biomechanical evaluation, orthopedic provocation tests, and mobility scoring.

treatmentSteps.title: Targeted Treatment Plan
treatmentSteps.desc: Hands-on manual therapy, modern pain relief modalities, and guided progressive muscle retraining.

treatmentSteps.title: Progress & Follow-up
treatmentSteps.desc: Custom video home exercise prescription, workplace ergonomic guidance, and periodic maintenance checks.

faqs.question: Can targeted physiotherapy really help me avoid surgery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Non-surgical computerized spinal decompression and targeted manual protocols relieve pressure on nerves and restore joint biomechanics, successfully averting surgery in over 92% of moderate-to-severe orthopedic cases.

faqs.question: How soon can I expect noticeable pain relief?
faqs.answer: Most patients experience significant symptom relief (40% to 60%) within 3 to 4 sessions through our acute pain relief modalities, followed by structured functional rehabilitation.

faqs.question: Do I need an MRI scan or physician's prescription for my first visit?
faqs.answer: If you already have reports or MRI scans, please bring them along. However, they are not mandatory — our therapists perform full clinical orthopedic assessments on Day 1.

faqs.question: Do you offer doorstep home visit physiotherapy?
faqs.answer: Yes. For senior citizens, post-operative patients, or individuals with mobility restrictions, our certified senior therapists provide dedicated home visit sessions with portable therapy equipment.
